observation.source: Five sanitized read-only operator observations of deployment metadata, exact environment patch structure, private snapshot comparisons and deployment image/mount field shapes. No provider request was executed while constructing this fixture.
observation.reconstruction: Synthetic identities replace every live identity; values are withheld. The comparison booleans are retained from the read-only evidence, not inferred from Hypervibe requests or mocks.

sources.transformation: Full official schema rendered as lexicographically sorted SDL with descriptions omitted; fields, arguments, types, defaults and deprecations retained.

officialContractCoverage: Deployment and EnvironmentPatch field names, nullability and operation signatures.
serviceInstanceDeployV2 acknowledges a deployment ID; volumeCreate acknowledges a volume ID.
Scoped deployment and raw/unrendered variable observation interfaces.

hypervibeAcceptanceRule.scope: A separately reviewed initialization reconciliation may accept a current deployment only after exact scoped storage-attachment patch, current deployment, preserved storage/configuration and raw snapshot checks. Do not infer actor ownership or causal lineage from timing or matching configuration.
hypervibeAcceptanceRule.immutableAcknowledgment: Preserve the original acknowledged deploymentId in progress and completion history.
hypervibeAcceptanceRule.effects: The reconciliation records separate verified identity; it does not authorize another volume creation, deployment, credential write, cleanup or SQL execution.

limitations: Existing schema/documentation pins are reused unchanged; no claim is made that the live server ran the pinned CLI revision.
Opaque nested fields are supported by this narrow redacted observation, not by GraphQL type validation.
Provider-documented request-to-patch or predecessor-to-successor lineage remains unavailable.
The separate receipt example describes Hypervibe policy, not a Railway API payload.
Tests consuming this evidence must label additional values and negative scenarios as synthetic and retain ordinary acceptance coverage.
